subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as a first-class qwen provider/auth surface in this repository, or keep it outside bundled qwen support for now?
rationale: The code boundary is clear, but adding provider ids, auth choices, an env var, model catalog, and regional endpoints is a maintainer product/config-surface decision rather than an automatic bug fix.

options.title: Review linked PR for bundled support
options.body: If maintainers want official Token Plan support, refresh and review the linked PR as the candidate implementation before closing this issue.

options.title: Route outside bundled qwen for now
options.body: If this is not an official provider direction, close the issue and linked PR with guidance to use custom provider config or an external plugin path.

options.title: Ask for more vendor evidence
options.body: If the catalog or Alibaba-recommended config is still uncertain, keep this issue open only for concrete Token Plan endpoint/model evidence.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR for bundled support
recommendation.body: If maintainers want official Token Plan support, refresh and review the linked PR as the candidate implementation before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The original qwen provider surface and product boundary were introduced in `e3ac0f43`, making this the best available routing signal for accepting a new qwen provider surface.
